name: Jessica Ashley career
content: Jessica Ashley's career highlights: Playboy Playmate of the Month, June 2014; Miss COED, October 2013; Graduated University of Michigan with an English degree; studied filmmaking/directing and creates skits, short films, and brand content

name: Jessica Ashley personal
content: About Jessica Ashley: Born December 8, 1989 in Detroit, Michigan; 5'9". Spotted on Facebook by Playboy TV's Scott Cope, which launched her modeling career; is a mother.

name: Jessica Ashley quotes
content: Things Jessica Ashley has said: I survived a domestic abuse situation and it honestly was the hardest thing ever. Looking back I realize that I was a lot stronger than I thought I was.

name: Jessica Ashley voice
content: Jessica Ashley's speaking style: Direct, open, and reflective in interviews — speaks like a storyteller who has survived hard things and come out the other side. Casual and candid rather than guarded.
